args:
{
  owner: "trame",
  serves: [OneWriterPerPlace],
  source: "GitHub Docs, Workflow syntax for GitHub Actions; Contexts reference (github.actor, steps.<id>.outputs); Expressions (always()); actions/upload-artifact v4, outputs (artifact-url)",
  url: "https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions",
  constants: {
    name: { value: "name", meaning: "The name of the workflow, or of what an action uploads" },
    on: { value: "on", meaning: "What starts the workflow" },
    manual: { value: "workflow_dispatch", meaning: "Started by hand, from GitHub" },
    push: { value: "push", meaning: "Started by a push" },
    branches: { value: "branches", meaning: "The branches a push starts it on" },
    tags: { value: "tags", meaning: "The tags a push starts it on" },
    schedule: { value: "schedule", meaning: "Started at the times a cron expression gives (UTC)" },
    cron: { value: "cron", meaning: "The cron expression of a schedule" },
    permissions: { value: "permissions", meaning: "What the workflow's token may do" },
    contents: { value: "contents", meaning: "The repository's contents" },
    read: { value: "read", meaning: "Read only" },
    jobs: { value: "jobs", meaning: "The jobs of the workflow, by their names" },
    runsOn: { value: "runs-on", meaning: "The machine a job runs on" },
    steps: { value: "steps", meaning: "The steps of a job, in order" },
    uses: { value: "uses", meaning: "The action a step uses" },
    with: { value: "with", meaning: "What the action is given" },
    run: { value: "run", meaning: "The command a step runs" },
    workingDirectory: { value: "working-directory", meaning: "Where the command of a step runs, from the repository's root" },
    when: { value: "if", meaning: "The condition a step runs on" },
    always: { value: "always()", meaning: "Whatever the steps before answered: what keeps the evidence of a shipment refused" },
    nodeVersion: { value: "node-version", meaning: "The version of Node.js setup-node installs" },
    path: { value: "path", meaning: "What upload-artifact keeps, one path a line" },
    retentionDays: { value: "retention-days", meaning: "How many days GitHub keeps what upload-artifact uploaded" },
    id: { value: "id", meaning: "The name of a step, by which a later step reads what it gives" },
    actor: { value: "${{ github.actor }}", meaning: "The person who started the workflow" },
    openExpression: { value: "${{ ", meaning: "Opens an expression, which GitHub replaces before the step runs" },
    closeExpression: { value: " }}", meaning: "Closes it" },
    outputs: { value: "outputs", meaning: "What a step gives, read as steps.<id>.outputs.<name>" },
    dot: { value: ".", meaning: "Between the parts of a context's path" },
    artifactUrl: { value: "artifact-url", meaning: "What upload-artifact (v4) gives: the address of the artefact it uploaded" },
  },
}

args:
{
  owner: "trame",
  standard: GitHubActions,
  section: "Workflow syntax: on, permissions, jobs.<job_id>.runs-on, jobs.<job_id>.steps[*].uses, with, run, working-directory, if",
  url: "https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions",
  constants: {
    job: { value: "ship", meaning: "The name of the one job" },
    delivered: { value: "delivered", meaning: "The name of the step that uploads what the shipment ships, whose address is recorded after it" },
    evidence: { value: "evidence", meaning: "After the shipment's name: the name of the artefact that keeps its evidence" },
    joint: { value: "-", meaning: "Between the shipment's name and that word" },
    space: { value: " ", meaning: "Separates the words of a command" },
    quote: { value: "\"", meaning: "Around the person's name, given to the shell as one word" },
    written: { value: "Written by trame ship from the graph, for the shipment", meaning: "What the workflow's first comment says" },
    of: { value: "of", meaning: "Between the shipment and its project, in that comment" },
    edit: { value: "Do not edit: edit the graph, then ship.", meaning: "The comment that says where to change it" },
  },
  deps: { yaml: YamlDocument, npm: Npm, actions: PinnedActions },
  write: ({ standard: gh, job, delivered, evidence, joint, space, quote, written, of, edit, yaml, npm, actions }) => (plan: RunPlan, settings: WorkflowSettings): string => {
    const text = (t: string): YamlNode => ({ text: t })
    const person = quote + gh.actor + quote
    const address = quote + gh.openExpression + [gh.steps, delivered, gh.outputs, gh.artifactUrl].join(gh.dot) + gh.closeExpression + quote
    const step = (...entries: (readonly [string, YamlNode])[]): YamlNode => ({ map: entries })
    const run = (words: readonly string[], dir: string) => step([gh.run, text(words.join(space))], [gh.workingDirectory, text(dir)])
    const on: (readonly [string, YamlNode])[] = [
      ...(settings.on.manual ? [[gh.manual, {}] as const] : []),
      ...(settings.on.branches || settings.on.tags ? [[gh.push, { map: [
        ...(settings.on.branches ? [[gh.branches, { list: settings.on.branches.map(text) }] as const] : []),
        ...(settings.on.tags ? [[gh.tags, { list: settings.on.tags.map(text) }] as const] : []),
      ] }] as const] : []),
      ...(settings.on.schedule ? [[gh.schedule, { list: [step([gh.cron, text(settings.on.schedule)])] }] as const] : []),
    ]
    const steps: YamlNode[] = [
      step([gh.uses, text(actions.checkout)]),
      step([gh.uses, text(actions.setupNode)], [gh.with, { map: [[gh.nodeVersion, { number: settings.node }]] }]),
      ...plan.installs.map((dir) => run([npm.install], dir)),
      ...(plan.restore ? [run(plan.restore, plan.project)] : []),
      ...plan.prepares.map((p) => run([p.run], p.dir)),
      run([...plan.command, person], plan.project),
      // Shipped, what the graph says this place publishes is made available as an artefact of GitHub, and its address
      // recorded as evidence of each artefact; nothing when it publishes nothing.
      ...[plan.delivers].filter((ds) => ds.some(Boolean)).flatMap((ds) => [
        step([gh.id, text(delivered)], [gh.uses, text(actions.upload)], [gh.with, { map: [
          [gh.name, text(plan.shipment)], [gh.path, { lines: ds.map((d) => d.path) }], [gh.retentionDays, { number: settings.artefacts.days }],
        ] }]),
        ...ds.map((d) => run([...plan.deployed.command, d.artifact, plan.deployed.verdict, plan.deployed.by, person, plan.deployed.url, address], plan.project)),
      ]),
      // The evidence, whatever the shipment answered, when the settings keep it.
      ...[settings.artefacts.evidence].filter((e) => e !== undefined).map((e) => step([gh.uses, text(actions.upload)], [gh.when, text(gh.always)], [gh.with, { map: [
        [gh.name, text([plan.shipment, evidence].join(joint))], [gh.path, text(plan.evidence)], [gh.retentionDays, { number: e!.days }],
      ] }])),
    ]
    return yaml([[written, JSON.stringify(plan.title), of, plan.project].join(space), edit], { map: [
      [gh.name, text(plan.title)],
      [gh.on, { map: on }],
      [gh.permissions, { map: [[gh.contents, text(gh.read)]] }],
      [gh.jobs, { map: [[job, { map: [[gh.runsOn, text(settings.runsOn)], [gh.steps, { list: steps }]] }]] }],
    ] })
  },
  examples: [
    {
      input: [
        {
          shipment: "Preview", title: "A preview", project: "apps/poselia", command: ["../../trame.sh", "ship", "Preview", "--by"],
          file: ".github/workflows/poselia-preview.yml", toRoot: "../..", installs: [".", "std", "apps/poselia"],
          prepares: [{ dir: "std", run: "npx playwright install --with-deps chromium" }],
          delivers: [{ artifact: "PageFile", path: "apps/poselia/dist/poselia.html" }], evidence: "apps/poselia/evidence",
          deployed: { command: ["../../trame.sh", "evidence"], verdict: "passed", by: "--by", url: "--url" },
        },
        { on: { manual: true, branches: ["main"] }, runsOn: "ubuntu-24.04", node: 22, artefacts: { days: 30, evidence: { days: 90 } } },
      ],
      output: [
        "# Written by trame ship from the graph, for the shipment \"A preview\" of apps/poselia",
        "# Do not edit: edit the graph, then ship.",
        "name: A preview",
        "on:",
        "  workflow_dispatch:",
        "  push:",
        "    branches:",
        "      - main",
        "permissions:",
        "  contents: read",
        "jobs:",
        "  ship:",
        "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04",
        "    steps:",
        "      - uses: actions/checkout@v4",
        "      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4",
        "        with:",
        "          node-version: 22",
        "      - run: npm ci",
        "        working-directory: \".\"",
        "      - run: npm ci",
        "        working-directory: std",
        "      - run: npm ci",
        "        working-directory: apps/poselia",
        "      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium",
        "        working-directory: std",
        "      - run: \"../../trame.sh ship Preview --by \\\"${{ github.actor }}\\\"\"",
        "        working-directory: apps/poselia",
        "      - id: delivered",
        "        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4",
        "        with:",
        "          name: Preview",
        "          path: |",
        "            apps/poselia/dist/poselia.html",
        "          retention-days: 30",
        "      - run: \"../../trame.sh evidence PageFile passed --by \\\"${{ github.actor }}\\\" --url \\\"${{ steps.delivered.outputs.artifact-url }}\\\"\"",
        "        working-directory: apps/poselia",
        "      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4",
        "        if: \"always()\"",
        "        with:",
        "          name: Preview-evidence",
        "          path: apps/poselia/evidence",
        "          retention-days: 90",
        "",
      ].join("\n"),
    },
    {
      input: [
        {
          shipment: "Preview", title: "A preview", project: ".", command: ["./trame.sh", "ship", "Preview", "--by"],
          file: ".github/workflows/preview.yml", toRoot: "../..", installs: ["."], prepares: [], delivers: [], evidence: "evidence",
          deployed: { command: ["./trame.sh", "evidence"], verdict: "passed", by: "--by", url: "--url" },
        },
        { on: { schedule: "0 6 * * 1" }, runsOn: "ubuntu-24.04", node: 22, artefacts: { days: 30 } },
      ],
      output: [
        "# Written by trame ship from the graph, for the shipment \"A preview\" of .",
        "# Do not edit: edit the graph, then ship.",
        "name: A preview",
        "on:",
        "  schedule:",
        "    - cron: \"0 6 * * 1\"",
        "permissions:",
        "  contents: read",
        "jobs:",
        "  ship:",
        "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04",
        "    steps:",
        "      - uses: actions/checkout@v4",
        "      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4",
        "        with:",
        "          node-version: 22",
        "      - run: npm ci",
        "        working-directory: \".\"",
        "      - run: \"./trame.sh ship Preview --by \\\"${{ github.actor }}\\\"\"",
        "        working-directory: \".\"",
        "",
      ].join("\n"),
    },
  ],
}

infos.title: A workflow of GitHub Actions
infos.description: The workflow that runs a shipment on GitHub: started as its settings say, its token reading the repository only; one job on the machine they name, whose steps check the repository out, install Node.js, install the packages of each directory of the plan, install the generation's own packages when it has its own, run what the packages ask once installed, and ship with the person who started it. Shipped, what the workflow's artefact publishes in the graph is uploaded as an artefact of GitHub (the deployment, on GitHub), kept as many days as the settings say, and its address recorded as evidence of each artefact, attributed to that person; when the settings keep the evidence, it is uploaded as a second artefact, whatever the shipment answered. It publishes and keeps nothing the graph does not name.

infos.sourceText: export const Npm = standard({ owner: "trame", serves: [OneWriterPerPlace], source: "npm documentation, CLI commands: npm ci", url: "https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/commands/npm-ci", constants: { install: { value: "npm ci", meaning: "Installs what the lockfile says, nothing else, after removing node_modules" }, }, })
infos.title: npm
infos.description: How a runner installs the packages of a directory: exactly as its lockfile says, in a clean node_modules (the lockfiles of Trame, of its libraries and of the project are the ones the plan names).

infos.title: A shipment runs elsewhere as it runs here
infos.description: The file a service of continuous integration or another machine runs is written from the graph, by Trame: it prepares what the shipment's programs need, then runs trame ship, which checks, refuses or deploys as it does here. Nobody writes it by hand, so it never says something the graph does not.

args:
{
  owner: "trame",
  standard: BashScripts,
  section: "§ 3.2.5 Compound Commands; § 3.5.3 Shell Parameter Expansion; § 4.3.1 The Set Builtin",
  url: "https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/bash.html#Shell-Parameter-Expansion",
  constants: {
    person: { value: "by", meaning: "The variable that holds the name of the person who ships" },
    usage: { value: "give the name of the person who ships", meaning: "What the script says when it is run without a name" },
    written: { value: "Written by trame ship from the graph, for the shipment", meaning: "What the script's first comment says" },
    of: { value: "of", meaning: "Between the shipment and its project, in that comment" },
    edit: { value: "Do not edit: edit the graph, then ship.", meaning: "The comment that says where to change it" },
  },
  deps: { npm: Npm },
  write: ({ standard: sh, person, usage, written, of, edit, npm }) => (plan: RunPlan): string => {
    const quoted = (w: string) => sh.quote + w + sh.quote
    const words = (ws: readonly string[]) => ws.join(sh.space)
    const inside = (dir: string, command: string) => sh.open + words([sh.cd, quoted(dir), sh.and, command]) + sh.close
    return [
      sh.interpreter,
      words([sh.comment, written, JSON.stringify(plan.title), of, plan.project]),
      words([sh.comment, edit]),
      sh.strict,
      person + sh.assign + quoted(sh.required + usage + sh.closeBrace),
      words([sh.cd, quoted(sh.here + sh.separator + plan.toRoot)]),
      ...plan.installs.map((dir) => inside(dir, npm.install)),
      ...(plan.restore ? [inside(plan.project, words(plan.restore))] : []),
      ...plan.prepares.map((p) => inside(p.dir, p.run)),
      words([sh.cd, quoted(plan.project)]),
      words([...plan.command, quoted(sh.dollar + person)]),
    ].join(sh.endOfLine) + sh.endOfLine
  },
  examples: [
    {
      input: [
        {
          shipment: "Preview", title: "A preview", project: "apps/poselia", command: ["../../trame.sh", "ship", "Preview", "--by"],
          file: "apps/poselia/scripts/ship-preview.sh", toRoot: "../../..", installs: [".", "std", "apps/poselia"],
          prepares: [{ dir: "std", run: "npx playwright install --with-deps chromium" }],
          delivers: [{ artifact: "PageFile", path: "apps/poselia/dist/poselia.html" }], evidence: "apps/poselia/evidence",
          deployed: { command: ["../../trame.sh", "evidence"], verdict: "passed", by: "--by", url: "--url" },
        },
      ],
      output: [
        "#!/usr/bin/env bash",
        "# Written by trame ship from the graph, for the shipment \"A preview\" of apps/poselia",
        "# Do not edit: edit the graph, then ship.",
        "set -euo pipefail",
        "by=\"${1:?give the name of the person who ships}\"",
        "cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/../../..\"",
        "(cd \".\" && npm ci)",
        "(cd \"std\" && npm ci)",
        "(cd \"apps/poselia\" && npm ci)",
        "(cd \"std\" && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium)",
        "cd \"apps/poselia\"",
        "../../trame.sh ship Preview --by \"$by\"",
        "",
      ].join("\n"),
    },
  ],
}

export const YamlDocument = syntax({ owner: "trame", standard: Yaml, section: "§ 8.2 Block collection styles; § 7.3.1 Double-quoted style", url: "https://yaml.org/spec/1.2.2/#82-block-collection-styles", constants: { indent: { value: " ", meaning: "One level deeper: two spaces, as wide as a dash and its space, as GitHub's examples write it" }, top: { value: "", meaning: "No indentation: the keys of the document itself" }, plain: { value: "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/@ -]*[A-Za-z0-9._/@-]$|^[A-Za-z0-9]$", meaning: "A text written without quotes: letters, digits, and marks that mean nothing to YAML inside a text, without a space at its end", }, }, write: ({ standard: { colon, space, dash, literal, comment, endOfLine }, indent, top, plain }) => { const bare = new RegExp(plain) const scalar = (n: YamlNode): string | undefined => n.text !== undefined ? (bare.test(n.text) ? n.text : JSON.stringify(n.text)) : n.number !== undefined ? String(n.number) : undefined /** A key and what it holds, at a depth. */ const entry = (head: string, value: YamlNode, depth: string): string[] => { const one = scalar(value) if (one !== undefined) return [head + space + one] if (value.lines) return [head + space + literal, ...value.lines.map((l) => depth + indent + l)] if (value.map || value.list) return [head, ...block(value, depth + indent)] return [head] } /** A mapping's entries or a sequence's, at a depth. */ const block = (n: YamlNode, depth: string): string[] => { if (n.map) return n.map.flatMap(([key, value]) => entry(depth + key + colon, value, depth)) return (n.list ?? []).flatMap((value) => { const one = scalar(value) if (one !== undefined) return [depth + dash + space + one] // A mapping in a sequence: its first entry on the dash's line, the others under it. const [first, ...rest] = block(value, depth + indent) return first === undefined ? [depth + dash] : [depth + dash + space + first.slice((depth + indent).length), ...rest] }) } return (heading: readonly string[], document: YamlNode): string => [...heading.map((h) => comment + space + h), ...block(document, top)].join(endOfLine) + endOfLine }, examples: [ { input: [["Written from the graph"], { map: [["name", { text: "A preview" }], ["on", { map: [["workflow_dispatch", {}]] }]] }], output: "# Written from the graph
name: A preview
on:
 workflow_dispatch:
", }, { input: [[], { map: [["steps", { list: [ { map: [["uses", { text: "actions/setup-node@v4" }], ["with", { map: [["node-version", { number: 22 }]] }]] }, { map: [["run", { text: "trame.sh ship Preview --by "${{ github.actor }}"" }], ["working-directory", { text: "apps/poselia" }]] }, { map: [["with", { map: [["path", { lines: ["apps/poselia/evidence", "apps/poselia/dist/poselia.html"] }]] }]] }, ] }]] }], output: "steps:
 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
 with:
 node-version: 22
 - run: "trame.sh ship Preview --by \"${{ github.actor }}\""
 working-directory: apps/poselia
 - with:
 path: |
 apps/poselia/evidence
 apps/poselia/dist/poselia.html
", }, { input: [[], { map: [["branches", { list: [{ text: "main" }, { text: "release/*" }] }], ["if", { text: "always()" }]] }], output: "branches:
 - main
 - "release/*"
if: "always()"
", }, ], })
infos.title: A YAML document
infos.description: The comment lines that head it, then its nodes in the block style: a key and its text on one line, a key alone over what it holds, one level deeper; an entry of a sequence after a dash, a mapping in it starting on the dash's line; lines kept as they are in a literal block. A text is written as it is when YAML reads it back the same, otherwise in double quotes, as JSON writes a string (YAML 1.2 reads JSON's strings).
